question: Does air daily temperature range relate more strongly to nighttime cooling and early-morning water minima than to daytime warming and afternoon water maxima in the fixed 2025 warm-season holdout?

water_filter.timestamp_grid: local wall-clock timestamps exactly on 15-minute grid

daily_targets.A24: least-squares first-harmonic amplitude sqrt(beta_sin^2 + beta_cos^2), using local decimal hour over all retained observations for a date
daily_targets.S_night: OLS slope in degrees C/hour over local timestamps [18:00, next day 06:00), calculated within same-date anchor; requires at least 40 retained points
daily_targets.S_day: OLS slope in degrees C/hour over local timestamps [06:00, 18:00), requires at least 40 retained points
daily_targets.morning_valley: minimum retained water temperature at local hours [04:00, 10:00) on the date
daily_targets.afternoon_peak: maximum retained water temperature at local hours [12:00, 18:00) on the date
daily_targets.clear_slope_sign_prediction: air_range coefficient negative for S_night and morning_valley; near zero for S_day and afternoon_peak
daily_targets.relative_association_prediction: within each site, absolute standardized air_range coefficient is larger for S_night than S_day and for morning_valley than afternoon_peak

pairing_and_models.join: exact site and local calendar date; require finite air_mean, air_range, positive flow, and valid target
pairing_and_models.baseline: OLS with intercept, month indicators May-September (May reference), air_mean, and natural log(flow)
pairing_and_models.fit: separate models per site and target using only 2014-2022 rows; ordinary least squares; no tuning
pairing_and_models.prediction: single 2025 holdout; report baseline MAE and expanded MAE, plus paired per-day MAE improvement baseline minus expanded

uncertainty.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap of 2025 daily MAE improvements, 28 consecutive date rows per block, 2000 replicates, RNG seed 20261103, percentile 95% interval
uncertainty.time_order: sort by date within site and target before resampling
uncertainty.n_blocks: ceil(number of valid test rows / 28); sample block starts uniformly with replacement and truncate concatenated blocks to original n

reporting.strata: report all three water stations individually; identify 10396000 as OPHI weather source and 11501000/11502500 as shared OCHI source; do not count shared OCHI as independent meteorological replication
provenance_checks: USGS A qualifier retention and raw/eligible sample counts
reporting.interpretation_boundary: predictive improvement or association does not establish heat-exchange mechanism
reporting.failure_rule: if fixed 2014-2022 IV files or exact-date paired covariates cannot be reproduced, stop primary comparison and report failure without replacing years, sites, filters, or metrics
